notes: buildArgumentsInit now groups consecutive properties by their first path component in declaration order instead of Dictionary(grouping:) + sort by name (direct fields first). Regression test 'splat with mixed direct and nested Arguments keeps declaration order' in Tests/SplatTests/Splat Tests.swift uses nested/direct/nested/direct fields whose alphabetical order differs from declaration order; it would not compile with the old expansion.
